title: Star Wars The Clone Wars Lightsaber Duels Nintendo Wii Complete CIB Tested Works
descriptionText:
Immerse yourself in the Star Wars universe with Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Lightsaber Duels for Nintendo Wii. This complete and tested game features intuitive controls that let you wield a Wii Remote like a real lightsaber. Battle with familiar characters from the Star Wars franchise and attack enemies by using the Force to turn environmental objects into weapons. 

This fighting game is published by LucasArts and rated T-Teen. It is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and features a thrilling storyline. Get ready to join the fight with Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Lightsaber Duels.
